fact: State Minister Zerihun Kebede said the national monitoring and evaluation platform, used by more than 113 public institutions, is designed to support institutions with real-time, AI-powered insights for policymaking.

The ATI with COSS and Protean eGov announced on 3 February 2026 the launch of Ethiopia OpenAgriNet, an AI-powered agricultural digital public infrastructure with location-specific AI recommendations, meant to reach millions of farmers by 2032, with ATI as first implementing partner.
